brief: A 6-step digital marketing plan that transforms clicks into customers.

slots.title: Know Your Audience
slots.body: Stop guessing who buys. Dig into data and build profiles that actually reflect your dream customers. It makes every later step way easier.

slots.title: Craft Bold Ads
slots.body: Your creative needs to stop the scroll. Use punchy headlines and retro visuals that spark curiosity in under three seconds.

slots.title: Build Fast Pages
slots.body: If it loads slowly, they bounce. Speed up your landing pages and keep the vibe consistent from ad to checkout.

slots.title: Capture Leads Smartly
slots.body: Not everyone buys on day one. Offer a juicy freebie or discount in exchange for an email you can nurture later.

slots.title: Nurture With Email
slots.body: Send value, not spam. Share tips, stories, and offers that guide subscribers from maybe to heck yes over time.

slots.title: Optimize And Convert
slots.body: Test headlines, buttons, and images weekly. Small tweaks to your funnel can unlock huge jumps in sales without extra ad spend.

slots.headline: Start Scaling Your Sales
slots.body: Ready to stop wasting budget? Put these six steps to work and watch your traffic finally pay off.
